tools.name: inspect_kicad_project
tools.description: Parse the .kicad_sch and .kicad_pcb in a KiCad project directory and return a compact JSON summary: components (ref, value, footprint, position), nets with their pins, track widths, via/drill sizes, zones, and unrouted ratsnest connections. Never returns raw S-expressions. Coordinates are absolute KiCad millimetres.

project_dir.description: Path to the KiCad project directory.

tools.name: run_dfm_and_erc_audit
tools.description: Run the electrical (ERC) and manufacturing (DFM) rule checks: USB-C CC pull-downs, decoupling capacitors per IC supply pin, I2C pull-ups, power trace width (IPC-2221), fab minimum track width, copper clearance, unrouted nets, via geometry, copper-to-edge, placement grid, courtyard overlap and schematic/PCB sync. Returns {pass, summary, issues[]} where each issue has id, rule, severity, title, detail, refs, nets, at [x, y] and a suggested fix.

project_dir.description: Path to the KiCad project directory.

tools.name: apply_pcb_patch
tools.description: Apply a batch of edits to the schematic and board (kept in sync). Placement and routing geometry is solved by the tool: components land on a clean grid next to the pad you name, tracks are routed Manhattan/45-degree on F.Cu/B.Cu with clearance verified. Send every fix in ONE call. Operation objects (field 'op'): set_pin_net {ref, pin, net} | add_component {kind: resistor|capacitor, value, pins: {"1": net, "2": net}, near: "REF.PIN", package?: "0603"} | route_net {net, width?} | reroute_net {net, width?} | set_track_width {net, width} | move_via {at: [x, y], to?: [x, y]} | delete_via {at: [x, y]} | move_footprint {ref, near?: "REF.PIN", to?: [x, y], rotation?} | add_track {net, layer, width?, points: [[x, y], ...]} | add_via {net, at: [x, y]} | stitch_pour {net} | rename_net {old, new} | set_value {ref, value}. Returns per-operation results and the number of connections still unrouted.

project_dir.description: Path to the KiCad project directory.

tools.name: render_board_svg
tools.description: Render the current board (Edge.Cuts outline, pads, F.Cu/B.Cu tracks, vias, silkscreen, ratsnest, highlighted DFM error markers and freshly patched items) and the schematic to SVG for the live dashboard. Runs automatically after every audit and patch; call it only if you need a refresh.

project_dir.description: Path to the KiCad project directory.
